meta.title: Audio Runtime Module
meta.summary: 不可变快照、pending overlay、整数 transport、固定 master FX 链与有界实时输出

cards.title: Concurrency
cards.body: Atomic32 claim; full 64-bit authority. Only control reclaims slots; admission bounds interference without audio waiting.

cards.title: Telemetry
cards.body: Audio/control value snapshots; only non-realtime readers lock. Transport has a separate control reader. Drain callbacks before lifecycle handoff.

cards.title: Master FX
cards.body: Fixed order filter, delay, reverb, stutter, gate, reverse, crush, cutter; values are 0..1000 and every period derives from the Bar, not wall clock.

cards.title: Forbidden boundary
cards.body: No allocation, destruction, lock, Project mutation, quantization, journal I/O or production test hook on the realtime thread.
